description: Encode or decode text with a Caesar shift cipher. Each letter is moved along the alphabet by the shift amount; a shift of 13 is ROT13. Only A to Z letters are changed, everything else is left as is. Decoding applies the opposite shift. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/caesar-cipher/

mode.description: 'encode' to apply the shift, 'decode' to reverse it (default encode)

shift.description: How many places to shift each letter (e.g. 3, or 13 for ROT13)

name: hopi_caesar_cipher

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Caesar cipher & ROT13
